comparison.objective: Run a two-lane ramp comparison and identify the higher-friction sled.
comparison.physical_skill: Arrange specimens, operate a release gate, observe stopping distances, and select the result.
comparison.success_condition: Both valid measurements establish a difference and only the higher-friction sled is placed on the target mat.
comparison.reason: Experimental comparison and selection are materially different from precision service transfer across a rail-jig interface.
